text:
Sam H.: heads up — prototyping a small grafana dashboard to correlate GPU cost, per-region routing, and provisioning headroom. want a quick sanity check before i commit the json :eyes:
Anya P.: nice. can you share the goals? is this for forecasting, realtime ops, or chargeback?
Sam H.: primarily ops + chargeback. two views: 1) live capacity/thermal/power so oncall can spot hotspots, 2) cost-slicing by tenant/region for weekly billing + reserved-capacity decisions.
Kai W.: recommend keeping a single row per rack with sparklines, and a cost panel grouped by billing_tag label. also surface autoscaler headroom.
Marcus: agreed. for alerts we should avoid pure 1m spikes — use a 5m rolling average and a burn-rate derived metric so SREs aren't paged for transient load.
Lina: can you paste the promql you're planning? easier to review that way.
Sam H.: sure — draft queries i'm using (will iterate):
```
# average GPU utilization per rack over 5m
avg_over_time(dcgm_gpu_utilization{job="dcgm-exporter"}[5m]) by (rack)

# 90th pct memory usage per node (MiB)
quantile_over_time(0.9, dcgm_memory_used_bytes{job="dcgm-exporter"}[1h]) / 1024 / 1024 by (instance)

# rack power draw (watts)
sum(dcgm_power_draw_watts{job="dcgm-exporter"}) by (rack)

# tenant cost estimate (tokens = gpu-seconds * price_per_region) -> simplified metric exported as gauge: tenant_gpu_seconds_total
# cost panel uses rate() * price lookup in Grafana transform
rate(tenant_gpu_seconds_total[5m]) by (tenant, region)
```
Anya P.: looks good. for cost transforms we usually pull price table via the grafana back-end and then do a math transform. avoid hardcoding prices in dashboard json.
Kai W.: alert tuning suggestion: alert when avg_over_time(dcgm_gpu_utilization[10m]) > 95 for 10m AND free_memory < 5% for same period. example condition: `avg_over_time(dcgm_gpu_utilization[5m]) > 92 and (1 - (avg_over_time(dcgm_memory_free_bytes[5m]) / avg_over_time(dcgm_memory_total_bytes[5m]))) > 0.95`
Marcus: add regional fallback info — if us-west-2 is saturated, show a small table of compatible model variants in other regions + expected additional latency. makes routing decisions visible to infra.
Sam H.: good call. i'll add a panel with: list_region_capacity(region, model_family) -> exported from admissions service as grafana table. until that exporter is live i'll use a stub panel with link to the runbook.
Lina: small UX note: put error budget burn widget next to SLO for each tenant, otherwise cost team can't connect the dots.
devops-bot: deploy queued: grafana/dashboards/gpu-cost-routing-draft.json -> staging (id: dash_gtk7) :rocket:
Sam H.: deploying to staging now. link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/dashboards/dash_gtk7 — please poke and LMK any panel that feels noisy.
Anya P.: for alerts, let's set silence windows for scheduled infra maintenance (we have weekly cluster upgrades tues 02:00-04:00 UTC). Marcus can you add to ops calendar?
Marcus: done. added recurring calendar block and annotated the alert rule with `maintenance_window: weekly-upgrades` so Ops can autoclear.
Kai W.: suggestion for panel thresholds: color 0-60 green, 60-80 amber, 80-100 red, with red only if sustained for >10m. keeps dashboards useful during load tests.
Sam H.: thanks all. i'll iterate on the queries and push the final JSON later today. tagging @Anya P. for chargeback validation and @Lina for SLO placement.
Anya P.: I'll review the cost transforms and pricing table integration after lunch. :thumbsup:
Lina: will review SLO widgets and error budget placement.
Sam H.: action items: 1) Sam — add rack table and region fallback panel, 2) Anya — pricing transform review, 3) Marcus — confirm maintenance window annotated on alert rules, 4) Kai — propose final color/thresholds. i'll update the staging link when ready.
Marcus: noted.
Sam H.: thanks everyone!
